description: A Claude Code skill bundle for bug hunting and external red-team work - 84 skills, 15 slash commands, 681 disclosed-report patterns curated across 24 core vulnerability classes, plus enterprise identity + infrastructure attack matrices.

written.description: A hunt skill for each web and API bug class, with a dispatcher that reads the scope and loads the ones that fit. Patterns from disclosed bug-bounty reports sit behind each one.

alive.last_commit_message:
feat(docs): bespoke terminal-HUD landing page for GitHub Pages (#232)

Replaces the stock just-the-docs home with a custom full-bleed hero
(docs/_layouts/home.html) matching the banner's operator-console brand:
near-black + hot-red, JetBrains Mono / Archivo, animated grid + glow +
scanlines, count-up stat HUD (84/58/681/15/5), a live-typed hunt-session
terminal (recon, scope gate, corroborated finding, 7-Q gate), capability
cards, an attack-surface reticle matrix, tabbed install with copy, an
AUTHORIZED-USE scope stamp, sponsor + footer. Reduced-motion safe,
responsive, zero external images (inline SVG/CSS) so it also opens
standalone. Inner docs pages keep just-the-docs.

index.md -> layout: home (keeps a crawler/no-JS fallback). _config.yml
description count corrected 51+ -> 84.

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
